review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: there is an opinion that students get best academic achieve should school reward, however, others believe that students make progress and effort to reward.

Admittedly, school give a reward for students have best gains that is certainly. The first, students have diligently applied themselves to their studies so they deserve their praises and privileges. It may encourage these students and other to study harder to win the rewards, and this can help students propel towards overall academic gains. Moreover, the kind of competition seen in almost every aspect of life where only the best individuals are rewarded. It make students are use to this reality and thrive in the face of fierce competition who enabled them to achieve success in later life.

However, improvement of students & also get results in school. The first, only a few smart students can come first and receive the rewards which cause others to think that their effort is futile because they cannot surpass those outstanding individuals. It's main reasons prone to feeling overwhelmed and disheartened that gradually lose the incentive to study. The second, emphasizing improvements can encourage all students be diligent in their studies and help students to understand that they need to constantly improve themselves, irrespective of how well they have been or are performing. The constant desire to outdo themselves to individuals even benefit themselves more than the competitive determination to win against all others.
In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that students have best academic result and students show improvements are gain reward in school.

review.overall: Em đã viết đủ bốn phần và có ý định bàn cả việc thưởng thành tích cao lẫn ghi nhận tiến bộ. Tuy nhiên, nhiều câu chưa thành câu tiếng Anh hoàn chỉnh: 'students get best academic achieve should school reward', 'It make students are use' và 'It's main reasons prone to feeling' làm người đọc phải đoán quan hệ ý. Body 2 có đủ hướng nản chí và tự cải thiện nhưng chưa nối được chủ thể với động từ; kết luận cũng chưa chốt chính sách bằng câu đúng. Mức độ vận dụng cấu trúc nền trong bài này rất yếu; em cần nghiêm túc viết lại từng câu, tự xác định chủ ngữ–động từ và đối chiếu từng lỗi với bản chữa. Em đã báo ý đầu bằng “The first” ở cả hai Body, rồi dùng “Moreover” và “The second” để báo ý sau. Những câu này còn nhiều lỗi ngữ pháp và quan hệ giải thích, nhưng không thể nói em thiếu tín hiệu chia hai lý do.

paragraphs: There is an opinion that schools should reward students with the best academic results, while others believe schools should also reward students who make progress. I believe both groups deserve recognition.

Admittedly, schools should reward students who achieve the best academic results. Firstly, students have diligently applied themselves to their studies, and thus they deserve their praises and privileges. This recognition may encourage these students and others to study harder to win the rewards, and this may improve overall academic results. Moreover, this kind of competition is seen in almost every aspect of life, where only the best individuals are rewarded. This competition helps students become used to this reality and thrive in the face of fierce competition, which may enable them to achieve success in later life.

However, schools should also reward students who show improvement. Firstly, only a few smart students can come first and receive the rewards, which may cause other students to think that their effort is futile. This is because they may feel unable to surpass those outstanding individuals. These students may feel overwhelmed and disheartened and gradually lose the incentive to study. Secondly, emphasizing improvements can encourage all students to be diligent in their studies and help them to understand that they need to constantly improve themselves, irrespective of how well they have been or are performing. The constant desire to outdo themselves may even benefit students more than the competitive determination to win against all others.
In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that schools should reward both students with the best academic results and those who show improvement.

task.text:
Some people think that school should reward students who show the best academic results, while others believe that it is more important to reward students who show improvements.
Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
